title: An explicit lifted-LMI cone that is not hyperbolic
exact_target: Characterize all full-dimensional pointed closed convex cones that are linear images of affine sections of positive semidefinite matrix cones, equivalently cones admitting a lifted linear-matrix-inequality representation. Is this class strictly larger than the class of hyperbolicity cones?
